name: Papermaker
summary: The Papermaker operates machinery both individually, or as part of a team, to convert raw materials to paper products in an operator or assistant role in the process for Pulping, Drying, Reeling, Coating, basic Maintenance and Quality Control Testing. Working with minimum supervision the Papermaker has knowledge of the entire process.
overview: Working as a machine operator or an assistant in the overall papermaking process converting raw materials into paper products.
